title: The wreath on the S
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The Lanes' wreath goes up on the S again. Wood draws the sign the third time this year. Fifteen marks. All filled. He looks at the S under the wreath longer than the others. He doesn't know why. The strip does: ten years.

panels.composition: SMALL WOOD LANES at night, every letter lit, the wreath on the S. Rain hatched. WOOD across the road in the coat with the pad. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a bowling alley's roofline neon sign fully lit at night with a wreath on its first letter, a young man in a chore coat drawing from across the rainy highway with a small dog, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The pad: the sign. Fifteen marks under it. All filled. The wreath.

image.prompt: close on a drawing pad with a lit sign drawn above a row of fifteen filled tally marks, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The S, under the wreath. Wood looking at it longer.

image.prompt: close on a lit neon letter S seen through a wreath's greenery, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood walking home. The sign behind. The S. He doesn't know why he looked. The strip does. November 2010.

image.prompt: a young man in a chore coat and a small dog walking away from a lit sign along a wet highway shoulder at night, black and white, no words
image.notes: The S: dark Nov 15, 2010 (objects.md). He looks longer; doesn't know why.

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: The S under the wreath. Ten years. The strip knows; he doesn't.
